title: Exploratory Midtraining for Robot Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.33130v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot policies predominantly learn from human-collected data emphasizing competent behavior, limiting coverage of the low-level behaviors needed to support autonomous improvement. We study how a form of midtraining can be used to build coverage over diverse low-level behaviors that connect challenging states of the robot and its environment to states from which further progress is possible ("connected behavioral coverage"). We also examine how this coverage supports downstream adaptation and online improvement. To this end, we introduce $\beta$-Data, a dataset collected via adversarial teleoperation, where a human adversary reversibly perturbs the environment while a human operator continues toward completion without resetting. We relabel trajectory segments with local outcomes in natural language and finetune a pretrained policy conditioned on recent action history. translated_title: 面向机器人策略的探索性中间训练
translated_abstract: 机器人策略主要从强调熟练行为的人类采集数据中学习，这限制了支撑自主改进所需的低层行为的覆盖范围。我们研究如何利用一种中间训练形式来构建对多样化低层行为的覆盖，这些行为能够将机器人及其环境的困难状态连接到可以继续推进的状态（即“连通性行为覆盖”）。我们还考察了这种覆盖如何支持下游适应与在线改进。为此，我们引入了 β-Data，这是一个通过对抗性遥操作采集的数据集：由一名人类“对抗者”对环境进行可逆扰动，而人类操作者则在不重置的情况下继续朝任务完成方向操作。我们用自然语言描述的局部结果对轨迹片段进行重新标注，并基于近期动作历史对预训练策略进行微调。所得策略表现出对更多低层行为的持续使用……
tldr: 提出探索性中间训练方法并构建通过对抗性遥操作采集的 β-Data 数据集，使机器人策略获得连通多样低层行为的覆盖，从而支持下游适应与在线自主改进。
en_tdlr: Introduces an exploratory midtraining approach with β-Data, a dataset collected via adversarial teleoperation, to build connected behavioral coverage of diverse low-level behaviors that supports downstream adaptation and online improvement of robot policies.
